cap:info.cap:headline: EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE. Swell surge alert for the low-lying coasts of the Nicobar group. Surge of 0.5 to 1.0 metres above the astronomical tide possible.
cap:info.cap:description: EXERCISE. Long-period swell generated in the southern Indian Ocean is expected to reach the Nicobar group overnight, producing a surge of 0.5 to 1.0 metres above the astronomical tide along low-lying stretches. A swell surge of this kind arrives under a clear sky and calm local winds, which is what makes it dangerous: there is no local weather to warn anyone. This is a rehearsal bulletin issued for a demonstration and describes no real forecast.
cap:info.cap:instruction: EXERCISE. Move fishing craft and gear well clear of the waterline. Avoid low-lying beaches and jetties overnight.

cap:parameter.cap:value: Drill bulletin authored for SagarDrishti. Not issued by INCOIS.
